title: My Quiet Bible · Soma, saba, gabana, ddamu
description: Soma, saba, gabana, ddamu. Baibuli mu nkyusa {{versions}} ne mu nnimi {{languages}}, eppeesa lya 🙏 okusaba mu ddoboozi ku by’osomye, n’ebibinja ebitono eby’ekyama okugabana essaala zo. Ya bwereere, tewali bulango, era ekola awatali mutimbagano.
sub: Baibuli yokka: tewali nteekateeka za kusoma, tewali bya kuddiriŋŋana, tewali bulango. Ya bwereere, era ekola awatali mutimbagano.
installAndroid: Giteeke ku ssimu yo eya Android
hint: Tewali kwewandiisa. Eggukira wano mu browser yo.
verseSub:
Enkyusa {{versions}} mu nnimi {{languages}}, zonna za bantu bonna oba nga zirina layisinsi enzigule.
          Olunyiriri lwe lumu, mu zimu ku zo:
biblesP: Enkyusa {{versions}} mu nnimi {{languages}}: King James, Louis Segond 1910, Luther, Reina-Valera, Baibuli y’Olwebbulaniya n’Endagaano Empya ey’Oluyonaani, ebitabo by’e Ethiopia mu Lungereza, Lufalansa ne Ge'ez, n’endala. Geraageranya okutuuka ku mukaaga ku lusegere.
searchP: Ekigambo, ebigambo ebiddiriŋŋana, ebigambo bibiri ebiri okumpi, mu Baibuli emu oba nnyingi, n’ebizuuliddwa nga bibaliddwa buli kitabo. Wandiika ekifo kya Baibuli era otuuka eyo. N’ennamba za Strong.
offlineP: Baibuli z’osoma zisigala ku ssimu yo. Mu nnyonyi, ku nsozi, mu kisenge wansi: eggukira ku lunyiriri we wakoma, awatali mutimbagano n’akatono.
marksP: Langi munaana, akawandiiko ku lunyiriri oba ku kitundu kyonna, akabonero ku bifo by’oddayo. Leeta bye wakuuma mu app endala eya Baibuli. Lamba olunyiriri ng’okozesa ekkalaamu ey’okumulisa, oba ssa langi ku nnukuta zaalwo.
devicesP: Bw’oba oyagala kyokka. Yingira ne passkey oba koodi eweerezeddwa ku email, era langi zo, obuwandiiko n’ensengeka bikugoberera. Ekyuma eky’okubiri kiyingira okuva ku kisooka ne link emu; tewali kya kuwandiika.
readingP: Ennukuta mukaaga, emu ekoleddwa abatalaba bulungi. Ebigambo binene nga bw’oyagala, n’amappeesa g’otoyinza kusubwa. Senvula okukyusa essuula. Kitangaala, Sepia oba Kizikiza, nga olupapula luno.
nots:
• Tewali nteekateeka za kusoma. Tewali bya kufumiitiriza bya buli lunaku. Tewali kikulondeddwa.
  • Tewali bulango. Tewali kukulondoola. Tewali cookies.
  • Tewali kusasula. Tewali kisibiddwa.
  • Teweetaaga akawunti. Yingira bw’oba oyagala okukwataganya kyokka.
free: My Quiet Bible ya bwereere, era ejja kusigala bw’etyo. Bw’ekuyamba, osobola okuyamba ettaala okusigala ng’eyaka. Tewali kijja kukyesigamako.
installSub: Olwo eggukira ku ssirini yonna nga app endala yonna, ejjukira w’obadde, era ekola awatali mutimbagano.
installSubComputer: Olwo eggukira mu ddirisa lyayo nga app endala yonna, ejjukira w’obadde, era ekola awatali mutimbagano.
iosSteps:
• Ggulawo Baibuli mu Safari.
  • Nyiga eppeesa lya menu mu katale k’endagiriro, olwo Share {svg}. Ku iPhone enkadde, Share eri mu katale ka wansi.
  • Nyiga View More, olwo Add to Home Screen {svg}.
  • Leka Open as Web App nga kiriko onyige Add. Ettaala erabika ku Home Screen yo.
iosNote: Kikole ng’oli mu Baibuli, so si ku lupapula luno, ettaala eggukire butereevu w’osoma. Kozesa Safari: browser endala ku iPhone ne iPad tezisobola bulijjo kugattako app.
orSafari: Oba, awatali App Store, okuva mu Safari:
androidNote: Okunyiga okumu. Tewali kiyita mu app store.
androidInstalled: Eteekeddwamu. Ggulawo ettaala wamu n’app zo endala.
androidSteps:
• Ggulawo Baibuli mu Chrome, oba browser gy’okozesa.
  • Ggulawo menu ya browser, emirundi mingi obutonnyeze busatu {svg} waggulu ku ddyo.
  • Nyiga Install and create shortcut (browser ezimu ziwandiika Add to Home screen).
  • Londa Install, so si Create shortcut. Olwo onyige Install nate.
  • Ettaala erabika wamu n’app zo endala.
computerNote: Eggukira mu ddirisa lyayo, nga app endala yonna.
computerInstalled: Eteekeddwamu. Ggulawo My Quiet Bible wamu n’app zo endala.
computerSteps:
• Ggulawo Baibuli mu Chrome oba Edge.
  • Nyiga akabonero k’okuteekamu ku nkomerero ya ddyo ey’akatale k’endagiriro, essirini eriko akasaale {svg}, olwo Install.
  • Ku Mac ne Safari: nyiga Share waggulu ku ddyo, olwo Add to Dock.
  • Oba kuuma tab eyo bw’etyo. Ekola mu ngeri y’emu, era ejjukira w’obadde.
footNote: Buli kiwandiiko kya bantu bonna oba kirina layisinsi enzigule. Layisinsi ya buli nkyusa eri mu app.
prayP: mu ddoboozi, n’eppeesa limu, ku by’okamala okusoma.
shareP: essaala zo, bw’oyagala, n’abantu batono ab’okumpi naawe.
prayLong: Eppeesa lya 🙏 bulijjo weeri, okumpi n’akatale k’okunoonya. Linyige oyogere essaala yo mu ddoboozi. Eterekebwa wamu n’ennyiriri z’obadde osoma, oluvannyuma osobole okugiwulira nate n’olaba kye wasabira.
prayTicks:
• Tewali kya kuwandiika era tewali kya kuteekateeka.
  • Essaala zo zisigala ku ssimu yo, oba zikwataganyizibwa nga zisibiddwa n’ekisumuluzo ky’olina ggwe wekka.
circlesVerse: “Kubanga awali babiri oba basatu abakuŋŋaanye mu linnya lyange, nange ndi awo wakati mu bo.”
circlesLong: Bw’oyagala, kola ekibinja ekitono eky’ab’omu maka go oba mikwano gyo mitono. Gabana essaala, olunyiriri oba akawandiiko n’okunyiga okumu. Bawuliriza, baddamu n’ekigambo, oba baddamu ne 🙏, era buli omu asoma olunyiriri mu Baibuli ye.
circlesTicks:
• Si kya buwaze. Tewali kiva ku ssimu yo okuggyako ng’onyize Gabana.
  • Buli kibinja kirina ekisumuluzo kyakyo. Ab’omu kibinja bokka be basobola okuggulawo ebikirimu; wadde ffe tetusobola.
  • Enkuŋŋaana zeetaaga okuyingira okw’obwereere, n’ekisumuluzo oba koodi eweerezebwa ku email.
listenP: Kwata ku lunyiriri, oluvannyuma Wuliriza. Oba kwata ku Soma ng’ogoberera mu bbaala y’okunoonya, buli kigambo kimulisibwa nga kisomebwa. Abasomi ab’amazima basoma BSB, King James ne Louis Segond. Ku lw’emmotoka, mu ffumbiro, oba amaaso amakoowu.
